pages.text: Magnet upgrades are an evolution of the hopper upgrade and teleport items from a distance around them.$(p)The upgrades come in several strengths that affect their speed and collection radius. If multiple upgrades are used, their ranges will be added together, up to an upper limit.
The base level magnet upgrade collects a stack of items at its own height with a horizontal range of 1 block, every 20 ticks.$(p)Its vertical range extends up by 1 block.
The second level magnet upgrade collects a stack of items at its own height with a horizontal range of 4 blocks, every 10 ticks.$(p)Its vertical range extends up by 2 blocks.
The third level magnet upgrade collects a stack of items at its own height with a horizontal range of 8 blocks, every 5 ticks.$(p)Its vertical range extends up by 3 blocks.
